eval: () => { const el = document.querySelectorAll('[data-slot=session-row]')[1].querySelector('button'); const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerType: 'touch', pointerId: 1, isPrimary: true, clientX: r.left + 90, clientY: r.top + 14 })); return true }
